prompt:
Create a photorealistic architectural photograph of an imaginary modern public library. It is not any real building: do not copy or resemble any existing library.

View: from a high white balcony, looking down at about 45 degrees into a tall open atrium that runs through five floors. The open space is a long rectangle, crossed by two slim white bridges and one straight white staircase. Every floor edge has a white balustrade made of thin vertical bars. Behind the balustrades, long rows of low white shelves filled with books whose spines are plain and unreadable.

Light and colour: bright, soft daylight from a large skylight above the frame. Almost everything is white and very light grey, with pale stone floors. A few low seats in a muted deep green are the only colour.

Mood: calm, quiet, orderly, precise. Completely empty: no people, no signs, no text, no numbers, no logos, no screens.

Composition: wide 16:9 landscape. Keep the upper third light and simple, so a headline can sit over it. Straight vertical lines, no fisheye distortion, sharp detail, a real camera look (35 mm lens, f/8), not an illustration.

Output the largest size available.
